# Every partial or explicit empty group fails before any external command.
! skygo-ssh --host dgx --known-hosts kh --agent-binary agent jobs list
stderr 'go together'
! skygo-ssh --host dgx --known-hosts kh --agent-commit $COMMIT jobs list
stderr 'go together'
! skygo-ssh --host dgx --known-hosts kh --agent-digest $DIGEST jobs list
stderr 'go together'
! skygo-ssh --host dgx --known-hosts kh --agent-binary= jobs list
stderr 'go together'
! skygo-ssh --host dgx --known-hosts kh --source= --agent-binary agent --agent-commit $COMMIT --agent-digest $DIGEST jobs list
stderr exclusive
! stderr 'MODELED'
